status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.tolerated_failures: No member failure tolerated | {count} member failure tolerated | {count} member failures tolerated
status.no_clients_description: Modules that use Valkey get their own user when they connect to this instance.
status.warning_below_quorum_description: The cluster has {count} member(s). Automatic failover needs at least 3 members: with 1 or 2 the data store stops when a member stops. Install ns8-valkey on another node and join this cluster.
status.warning_members_down_description: Some Valkey processes of the cluster do not answer. Their replicas take over if the cluster still has a majority.
status.warning_cluster_down_description: The cluster does not serve all its slots: clients get errors until the missing members return.
status.warning_unreachable_description: No member of the cluster answers.
status.warning_no_redundancy_description: At least one primary has no replica on another member: a member failure would stop the cluster.
status.warning_not_running_description: The local Valkey server does not answer. Check the system logs.
status.warning_writes_need_replica_description: Consistency mode with a single member: writes stop whenever its replica process is down. Add members, or use the availability mode.
status.warning_writes_blocked_description: Consistency mode: a primary without a replica in sync refuses writes (NOREPLICAS) until a replica catches up.

settings.title: Settings
settings.role_standalone_description: One Valkey server on this node. The simplest choice: other modules use it with no cluster setup.
settings.role_initial: Initial node of a new cluster
settings.role_initial_description: Starts a Valkey Cluster on this node. A standalone server keeps its data. Install ns8-valkey on other nodes and join it: with 3 or more members the cluster survives the loss of one node.
settings.role_join_description: Becomes a member of a Valkey Cluster of another node. This instance must be empty: its data is replaced by its share of the cluster data.
settings.no_clusters_description: Configure an ns8-valkey instance of another node as initial node first.
settings.quorum_warning_description: This cluster will have {count} member(s). Automatic failover needs at least 3 members, each on its own node: with 2 members, the failure of either one stops the data store.
settings.leave_warning_description: The slots of this member are handed over to the other members, then this instance restarts empty as a standalone server.
settings.maxmemory_mb_helper: Per Valkey process. 0 means no limit. When the limit is reached, writes fail (no eviction).
settings.maxmemory_mb_invalid: Must be a whole number, 0 or more
settings.node_already_member: This node already has a member of this cluster
settings.leave_cluster_first: Leave the current cluster first: switch to standalone
settings.cluster_has_members: Other members are still in this cluster: remove them first
settings.instance_not_empty: This instance holds data: only an empty instance can join a cluster
settings.consistency_availability_description: Writes go on even when a primary has no replica in sync, and a replica always takes over a failed primary. Up to about one second of writes can be lost in a failover. Right for counters and caches, such as mail throttles.
settings.consistency_consistency_description: A primary accepts writes only while one of its replicas confirmed the data in the last 10 seconds, and a replica long out of touch does not take over. Fewer writes are lost, but writes stop while a primary has no replica in sync.
settings.consistency_warning_description: With one member, the only replica runs on the same node: writes stop whenever it is down. Add members on other nodes.
